title: luetkea hendersonii
intro: Luetkea hendersonii, commonly known as Henderson's luetkea or alpine luetkea, is a flowering plant species in the rose family, native to the western United States and Canada. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote digestive health, alleviate symptoms of indigestion and bloating, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Luetkea hendersonii include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and carminative effects, which may help soothe digestive discomfort, reduce inflammation, and alleviate cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to possess antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
